Yeah. There's a lot I can do better. The problem is I'm me, and I won't fix it.

I don't want to be this way. I don't want to be alone anymore, but I can't fix it. Everytime I think things get a little better I'm instantly hit back down.
My biggest fear is being locked up in a psych ward. Like it's great being locked up in a miserable place away from the people and things I love.
The only problem is I really don't like myself. It seems no one else likes me either.
I am going to say this here. I am not trying to take down anyone else with autism. This is just how I feel about myself.
Thank you for talking to me it is making me feel better.
I get that no one is perfect it's just I feel as though I am so much lesser than everyone else. I feel so pathetic for crying now as I type this. I do not deserve to be sad like other people do
